description: Returns the server-wide license limits as current count vs. maximum for Work Items, Documents/Pages, and projects, plus links to the default license slots. Use it to check remaining capacity before bulk-creating items or projects; for which user holds which license use `getLicenseAssignments`, and for the slot details `getLicenseSlots`.

fields.description: Sparse fieldset selector: an object keyed by resource type (e.g. `workitems`) whose value is a comma-separated list of attribute names to return (e.g. `id,title,status`), reducing payload size. Omit to return the default field set.

include.description: Comma-separated list of related resource types to embed in the response (e.g. `author,attachments`) so they don't require a separate follow-up call. Omit to return only the primary resource.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.
